beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Through the prophet Malachi, the LORD made a strange offer to a people holding back — bring everything in, and watch what I do.

timing.text: Through the prophet Malachi, the LORD made a strange offer to a people holding back — bring everything in, and watch what I do.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The storehouse was the place set apart for the Lord's house, and the tithe was the part meant for him.

timing.text: The storehouse was the place set apart for the Lord's house, and the tithe was the part meant for him.

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

timing.text: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A dare no king could make — test me, and see if I don't open the windows.

timing.text: A dare no king could make — test me, and see if I don't open the windows.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He is the only one in scripture who ever says: prove me. Put me to the test, and watch what I do.

timing.text: He is the only one in scripture who ever says: prove me.
Put me to the test, and watch what I do.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A pouring out, more than there is room to hold.

card.text: He invites you to test his goodness. Bring it all, and watch the windows open.
